pages.text: $(l)Ember Fireflies$() swarm in the Hellwood Jungle, Ember Grove and Meadow; $(l)Soul Fireflies$() in soul valleys and the Petrified Forest. Harmless.
Right-click a firefly with a $(item)Glass Bottle$() to catch it in a $(l)jar$(): a lantern that lights like a real one (ember: 15, soul: 12).
